    Dual representables and injective copresentations #

    For the category algebra Λ of a family F, the dual representable J_p = (D C(F p, F q))_q is the module D(e_p Λ) (in that paper's right-module notation D(Λ e_p)). A functional λ on a module X gives θ_λ : X → J_p, θ_λ(x)_q(h) = λ(h · x). Every finite-dimensional module embeds into a finite sum of the J_p, which gives the injective copresentations used in Lemma 2.9.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
